items.title: El Salvador oo sheegtay inay burburisay xarunta kooxda burcadda 400 Mawozo ee Haiti
items.summary: Madaxweynaha El Salvador Nayib Bukele ayaa sheegay in ciidamada militariga dalkiisa ay burburiyeen xarunta kooxda 400 Mawozo, oo ka mid ah kooxaha burcadda ugu waaweyn Haiti, weerar dhul iyo cir ah oo lagu qaaday dhisme ku yaalla duleedka caasimadda Port-au-Prince, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Port-au-Prince, caasimadda Haiti, oo laga sawiray hawada sare

items.title: Wariyadda Masar Lina Attalah oo maanta maxkamad loo celinayo, iyadoo xabsi u eg
items.summary: Wariyadda caanka ah ee Masar Lina Attalah, oo madax u ah warbaahinta madaxa-bannaan ee Mada Masr, ayaa Arbacada maanta ah la horkeenayaa maxkamad dembiyeed oo dib loogu qaadayo dacwad lagu eedeeyay ka shaqeyn shati la'aan iyo faafinta war been ah, sida ay werisay France 24.
items.imageAlt: Lina Attalah, madaxa Mada Masr, oo ka hadlaysa Bandhigga Saxaafadda Caalamiga ah ee Perugia, Talyaaniga, 2024

items.title: UNCTAD: isbeddelka cimiladu wuxuu dunida ka lumin karaa 10% wax-soosaarkeeda
items.summary: Hay'adda Ganacsiga iyo Horumarinta ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNCTAD) ayaa ka digtay in khasaaraha dhaqaale ee isbeddelka cimiladu uu gaari karo qiyaastii 10% wax-soosaarka guud ee adduunka haddii heerkulka dunidu kordho 3 darajo oo Celsius ah, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Rebeca Grynspan, xoghayaha guud ee UNCTAD, oo ku sugan Palais des Nations ee Geneva, 2021

items.title: Eric Zemmour oo ku dhawaaqay inuu mar labaad u tartamayo madaxweynaha Faransiiska
items.summary: Qoraaga iyo siyaasiga midigta fog ee Faransiiska, Eric Zemmour, ayaa Talaadadii telefishinka TF1 ka xaqiijiyay inuu musharax ka noqonayo doorashada madaxweynaha ee sannadka soo socda, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera oo ka soo xigatay wakaaladda AFP.
items.imageAlt: Eric Zemmour, siyaasiga midigta fog ee Faransiiska, April 2022

items.title: Ruushka oo dalka ka saaray diblomaasi Moldova ah, jawaab ka ah tallaabo Chisinau qaaday
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ayaa Talaadadii sheegtay inay dalka ka saartay shaqaale ka tirsan safaaradda Moldova, iyadoo ku tilmaantay jawaab ka ah go'aankii Moldova ee ahaa inay erido shaqaale safaaradda Ruushka ka tirsan, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ee magaalada Moscow

items.title: Erdoğan oo COP31 ku qabtay lix kulan, Turkiga iyo Sacuudigana saxiixeen heshiis koronto
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Antalya, oo ay ka socoto shirka cimilada ee COP31, ku qaabilay lix hoggaamiye iyo masuul, waxaana uu goobjoog ka ahaa saxiixa heshiis is-afgarad koronto oo u dhexeeya Turkiga iyo Sacuudi Carabiya.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Tamarta Turkiga Alparslan Bayraktar

items.title: Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka oo bilaabay codbixin go'aamineysa qaraarka xil ka qaadista Hegseth
items.summary: Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii bilaabay codbixin habraac ah oo go'aamineysa in qaraarka xil ka qaadista Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth dib loogu celiyo guddi ama loo gudbiyo codbixin kama dambays ah, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Hoolka Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka ee dhismaha Capitol-ka, Washington

items.title: Gianni Infantino oo laga yaabo in Congress-ka Mareykanka uu u yeero bisha January
items.summary: Madaxweynaha FIFA Gianni Infantino ayaa laga yaabaa in toddobaadyada soo socda, ugu dambeyn bisha January, uu waajib ku noqdo inuu ka jawaabo amarro yeedhid ah oo uu soo saaro Congress-ka Mareykanka, sida uu werinayo wargeyska Ingiriiska ee The Telegraph.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha FIFA Gianni Infantino

items.title: Ciidamada UNIFIL oo rasaas lagu furay intii ay ku sugnaayeen roondo koonfurta Lubnaan
items.summary: Ciidamada nabad-ilaalinta Qaramada Midoobay ee Lubnaan (UNIFIL) ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in qiyaastii 12 xabbadood lagu riday mid ka mid ah kooxahooda roondada ku jiray meel u dhow Wadi Jilu oo ka tirsan degmada Tyre, iyagoo aan magacaabin cidda ka dambeysay.
items.imageAlt: Askari ka tirsan ciidamada UNIFIL oo roondo ku jira xadka Blue Line ee koonfurta Lubnaan

items.title: Tanzania oo sheegtay inay 5-tii sano ee la soo dhaafay 604.6 bilyan oo shilin ku dhistay 676 dugsi
items.summary: Ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Dowlaha ee Maamulka Gobollada iyo Dowladaha Hoose ee Tanzania, Dr Festo Dugange, ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ku bixisay 604.6 bilyan oo shilin dhismaha 676 dugsi oo cusub iyo 34,464 musqulood, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.
items.imageAlt: Ardayda dugsiga hoose ee Nyakahoja ee magaalada Mwanza, Tanzania

items.title: Askari ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka oo Ingiriiska lagu xiray, looguna tuhmay basaasnimo Ruushka
items.summary: Booliska la-dagaallanka argagixisada ee London ayaa sheegay in askari 41 jir ah oo ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka lagu xiray meel u dhow magaalada Gloucester, iyadoo looga shakisan yahay inuu ku xadgudbay sharciga amniga qaranka ee la xiriira Ruushka.
items.imageAlt: Calaamadda xarunta New Scotland Yard ee Booliska Metropolitan Police ee London

items.title: Lewis Hamilton oo booqday xuduudda Masar iyo Gaza si uu u arko gargaarka bini'aadannimada
items.summary: Darawalka Formula 1 ee 7 jeer horyaalka adduunka ku guuleystay, Lewis Hamilton, ayaa Talaadadii booqday magaalada El Arish ee Masar iyo marinka Rafah, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay shaqaalaha gargaarka ee loo diyaarinayo Marinka Gaza.
items.imageAlt: Darawalka Formula 1 Lewis Hamilton

items.title: Aurélien Tchouaméni oo dhaawac awgiis uga baxay xulka Faransiiska
items.summary: Khadka dhexe ee Real Madrid, Aurélien Tchouaméni, ayaa ka tagaya xerada xulka Faransiiska kadib dhaawac uu ka gaaray agagaarka gumaarka, mana ciyaari doono kulamada Talyaaniga iyo Turkiga ee UEFA Nations League, sida ay wariyeen RMC Sport iyo L'Équipe.
items.imageAlt: Aurélien Tchouaméni oo u ciyaaraya xulka Faransiiska

items.title: Maamulka Trump oo soo jeediyay xeer ka saari kara 6.3 milyan oo qof barnaamijka gargaarka cuntada
items.summary: Wasaaradda Beeraha Mareykanka (USDA) ayaa Talaadadii daabacday xeer la soo jeediyay oo meesha ka saaraya u-qalmitaanka tooska ah ee barnaamijka SNAP, taasoo sida ay werisay Al Jazeera ka saari karta qiyaastii 6.3 milyan oo qof.
items.imageAlt: Suuq beereed ku yaal Baltimore oo lagu isticmaalo kaararka EBT ee gargaarka cuntada

items.title: Kirk Cousins oo dib ugu laabtay Minnesota Vikings, Raiders-na jagada waxay siiyeen Fernando Mendoza
items.summary: Kooxda Minnesota Vikings ayaa Kirk Cousins, oo ah quarterback 38 jir ah, ka heshay kooxda Las Vegas Raiders iyagoo bixinaya doorashada wareegga 3-aad ee 2027, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo The Guardian.
items.imageAlt: Kirk Cousins oo xiran dirayska Minnesota Vikings intii lagu jiray ciyaar NFL

items.title: Jim Jordan oo loo doortay hoggaamiyaha Jamhuuriga ee Aqalka Wakiilada Mareykanka, kadib lumintii aqlabiyadda
items.summary: Xildhibaannada Jamhuuriga ee Aqalka Wakiilada Mareykanka ayaa cod qarsoodi ah ku doortay Jim Jordan, oo ka socda gobolka Ohio kuna dhow Madaxweyne Donald Trump, si uu u beddelo Mike Johnson, toddobaad kadib markii xisbigu lumiyay aqlabiyadda doorashooyinkii xilliga dhexe.
items.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Xildhibaan Jim Jordan

items.title: Xeer-ilaalinta Mareykanka: hoggaamiye Kataib Hezbollah ah oo xabsi New York ka hagay qorshe weerar saldhig Ingiriis
items.summary: Dacwad cusub oo ay xeer-ilaalinta federaalka Mareykanka soo saartay ayaa lagu eedeeyay Mohammad Dawood Al-Saadi, oo haysta dhalashada Iran iyo Ciraaq, inuu isagoo xabsi ku jira New York hagay qorshe fashilmay oo lagu doonayay in lagu weeraro saldhigga ciidamada cirka ee RAF Fairford ee Ingiriiska.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarad dagaal oo Mareykan ah oo ka duulaysa saldhigga RAF Fairford ee Ingiriiska

items.title: Wasiirka Dowladaha Hoose ee Uganda oo amar ku bixiyay xarigga saraakiil ka tirsan degmada Ibanda
items.summary: Wasiirka Dowladaha Hoose ee Uganda, Balaam Barugahara, ayaa amar ku bixiyay in la xiro lagana joojiyo shaqada qaar ka mid ah saraakiisha dowladda hoose ee degmada Ibanda, kuwaas oo lagu eedeeyay musuqmaasuq, maamul xumo lacagaha dadweynaha iyo xadgudub xilka, sida ay werisay Nile Post.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Uganda Balaam Barugahara

items.title: Ingiriiska oo sheegay in habka dowladda ku-meel-gaarka ah uu wiiqay is-afgaradka siyaasadeed ee Koonfur Suudaan
items.summary: Ku-xigeenka Ergayga Joogtada ah ee Ingiriiska ee Qaramada Midoobay, Kate Foster, ayaa shir Golaha Ammaanka ee New York ka sheegay in habka cusub ee dowladda ku-meel-gaarka ah uu sii wiiqay is-afgaradka siyaasadeed, iyadoo qodobo muhiim ah oo heshiiska nabadda ee 2018 aan weli la fulin, sida ay werisay Eye Radio.
items.imageAlt: Qolka shirarka Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ee New York

items.title: Rabshado ka dhacay Bangladesh kadib markii taageerayaasha Sheikh Hasina ay dibadbax sameeyeen
items.summary: Booliska Bangladesh ayaa gaas ilmeysiiye iyo rasaas caag ah ku kala eryay taageerayaasha ra'iisul wasaarihii xilka laga tuuray Sheikh Hasina, kuwaas oo dalbanaya inay dalka dib ugu soo laabato, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Suuqa cusub ee degmada Gopalganj ee Bangladesh

items.title: Von der Leyen oo 50 milyan oo yuuro u ballan qaaday Bulgaria iyo Romania kadib weerarrada Badda Madow
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Guddiga Midowga Yurub, Ursula von der Leyen, ayaa ballan qaaday 50 milyan oo yuuro si loo dedejiyo xarun wadaag ah oo amniga badda oo ay Bulgaria iyo Romania ka hirgelinayaan Badda Madow, kadib weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn lagu qaaday maraakiib xamuul.
items.imageAlt: Dekedda Varna ee Bulgaria, oo ku taal xeebta Badda Madow

items.title: Uganda oo higsaneysa inay sannadkii soo saarto 210 milyan oo lammaane galoofyada caafimaadka
items.summary: Wasiirka Dowlaha ee Warshadaha Uganda, David Bahati, ayaa xariga ka jaray khadka 2-aad ee wax-soo-saarka warshadda East African Medical Vitals ee Namanve, taasoo lagu wado inay awoodda sannadlaha ah ka qaaddo qiyaastii 80 milyan ilaa 210 milyan oo lammaane, sida ay werisay Nile Post.
items.imageAlt: Galoofyada caafimaadka oo la baarayo

items.title: Iran oo sheegtay inaysan hakin ballanqaadyadeeda NPT, iyadoo kooxaha adag ay ka hadlayaan bam nukliyeer
items.summary: Iran ayaa sheegtay inaysan hakin waajibaadkeeda heshiiska ka-hortagga faafidda hubka nukliyeerka (NPT), hase yeeshee kormeerro caalami ah oo ballaaran oo lagu sameeyo goobaheeda ayaa weli fog, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta korontada nukliyeerka ee Bushehr, Iran

items.title: Maxkamad rafcaan oo ku taal London oo baabi'isay sharcigii Trinidad iyo Tobago ee mamnuucayay galmada khaniisiinta
items.summary: Maxkamadda rafcaanka ugu dambaysa ee Trinidad iyo Tobago, oo fadhigeedu yahay England, ayaa Talaadadii baabi'isay sharci qarniyo jiray oo dambi ka dhigayay galmada dadka isku jinsiga ah, sida ay werisay ABC News.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Middlesex Guildhall ee London, halkaas oo ay ku shaqeyso maxkamadda

items.title: Scott McTominay oo shaaciyay inuu daaweyn wadnaha ah helay intii lagu jiray Koobka Adduunka
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Napoli iyo xulka Scotland, Scott McTominay, ayaa sheegay inuu daaweyn lagu saxayo garaaca wadnaha oo aan caadi ahayn helay laba maalmood ka hor guushii Scotland ee Haiti bishii June ee Koobka Adduunka, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Scott McTominay oo u ciyaaraya Scotland ciyaartii Bolivia, June 2026

items.title: Xisbiga National Rally oo heshiis hordhac ah la gaaray bangiyo si loo maalgeliyo ololaha Le Pen
items.summary: Xisbiga midigta fog ee Faransiiska, National Rally, ayaa heshiis hordhac ah la gaaray laba bangi oo Yurub ah oo ku saabsan amaah dhan 10.6 milyan euro oo lagu maalgelinayo ololaha doorashada madaxtinimo ee Marine Le Pen, sida uu sheegay khasnajiga xisbiga.
items.imageAlt: Marine Le Pen, hoggaamiyaha xisbiga National Rally, May 2024

items.title: Masar oo sheegtay in ciidamadeedu ay bilooyin joogeen Sacuudi Carabiya ujeeddo difaac
items.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdelatty, ayaa sheegay in askar Masaari ah ay bilooyin badan joogeen Sacuudi Carabiya si ay u ilaaliyaan goobo muhiim ah kadib weerarro lagu qaaday boqortooyada, isagoo xusay in ciidamadaasi aysan u gudbi doonin Yemen.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdelatty

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo xaqiijisay kiis dhimasho ah oo qandhada jaallaha ah ee degmada Morobo
items.summary: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Koonfur Suudaan ayaa xaqiijisay in nin beeralay ah oo 48 jir ah oo ku noolaa degmada Morobo ee gobolka Central Equatoria uu u dhintay qandhada jaallaha (yellow fever), kadib safar uu ku tagay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo, sida uu werisay Radio Tamazuj.
items.imageAlt: Buurta Lujule ee degmada Morobo, Koonfur Suudaan

items.title: Pochettino oo la sheegay inuu xiiseynayo inuu ka tago xulka Mareykanka oo uu u dhaqaaqo Manchester United
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka ragga Mareykanka, Mauricio Pochettino, ayaa xiiseynaya inuu qaato shaqada tababarenimo ee Manchester United, xiisahaasna waa mid labada dhinac ah, sida ay wargeyska The Guardian u sheegeen ilo badan.
items.imageAlt: Mauricio Pochettino oo hoggaaminaya xulka Mareykanka ciyaartii Belgium, March 2026

items.title: Baarlamaanka Uganda oo amray baaritaan laba toddobaad ah oo ku saabsan maalgashiga Dei BioPharma
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Uganda, Jacob Oboth, ayaa faray guddiga sayniska iyo tiknoolajiyadda inuu laba toddobaad gudahood baaro maalgashiga 723.4 bilyan oo shilin ee dowladdu ku samaysay shirkadda Dei BioPharma, sida uu werisay Nile Post.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Baarlamaanka Uganda ee magaalada Kampala

items.title: Kenya oo safaaradeedii Haiti u wareejisay magaalada Mexico City
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Kenya ayaa sheegtay in xafiiska diblomaasiyadeed ee Port-au-Prince loo raray Mexico City, taas oo qayb ka ah dib-u-habeyn lagu sameynayo safaaradaha dalka, sida uu werisay Capital FM.
items.imageAlt: Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Arrimaha Dibadda Kenya, Korir Sing'oei, oo kulan ku leh Vienna

items.title: Eli Junior Kroupi oo markii ugu horreysay loogu yeeray xulka Faransiiska, isagoo beddelaya Marcus Thuram
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Bournemouth ee 20 jirka ah, Eli Junior Kroupi, ayaa tababaraha xulka Faransiiska Zinédine Zidane markii ugu horreysay u yeeray, si uu u beddelo Marcus Thuram oo dhaawac uga baxay xerada, sida ay werisay RMC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Eli Junior Kroupi oo u ciyaaraya Bournemouth ciyaar ay la yeesheen Fulham, May 2026

items.title: Jeneraal Muhoozi oo xiray bartiisa X kadib hanjabaad uu u diray Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Uganda
items.summary: Taliyaha Ciidamada Difaaca Uganda, Jeneraal Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa xiray bartiisa X kadib qoraallo uu ugu hanjabay Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Jessica Alupo inay xilka ka dhaqaaqdo, sida uu werisay wargeyska The Citizen.
items.imageAlt: Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Uganda, Jessica Alupo

items.title: Formula 1 oo xilli ciyaareedka ku soo gabagabeyn doonta Qatar iyo Abu Dhabi sidii loo qorsheeyay
items.summary: Formula 1 ayaa ku wargelisay garoonka Imola ee Talyaaniga in aan loo baahan doonin kayd ahaan, iyadoo tartannada Qatar (27 ilaa 29 November) iyo Abu Dhabi (4 ilaa 6 December) ay dhici doonaan sidii loo qorsheeyay inkasta oo ay socoto colaadda Mareykanka iyo Israa'iil ay la leeyihiin Iran, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarado ka duulaya jasiiradda Yas intii lagu jiray tartanka Abu Dhabi Grand Prix

items.title: Booliiska Faransiiska oo dad u xiray baaritaanka Mohamed Al Fayed
items.summary: Booliiska Faransiiska ayaa dad xiray kadib markii ay baareen saddex hanti oo uu ku jiro hotelka Ritz ee Paris, iyagoo ka shaqeynaya baaritaanka xadgudubyadii loo aaneeyay Mohamed Al Fayed, sida ay sheegtay warqad Booliiska Magaalada London (Met) u direen dhibbanayaasha, oo ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Hotelka Ritz ee fagaaraha Place Vendôme ee Paris

items.title: TAZARA oo joojisay tareenada u dhexeeya Mbeya iyo Makambako ilaa 1 December
items.summary: Hay'adda Tareenada Tanzania iyo Zambia (TAZARA) ayaa joojisay adeegyada tareenada rakaabka iyo xamuulka ee u dhexeeya Mbeya iyo Makambako ilaa 1 December 2026, kadib shil tareen xamuul oo burburiyay dhowr kiilomitir oo jidka tareenka ah, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.
items.imageAlt: Tareen TAZARA ah oo u socda Mbeya

items.title: Uganda oo sheegtay inay hakadka ka qaadi doonto qaar ka mid ah hay'adaha NGO-yada
items.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Uganda, Ephraim Kamuntu, ayaa sheegay in hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn ee la hubiyo inay xalliyeen walaacyadii laga qabay loo oggolaan doono inay dib u bilaabaan hawlahooda, kadib dib-u-eegis lagu sameeyay 10 hay'adood oo la hakiyay, sida uu werisay Nile Post.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Kampala Road ee caasimadda Uganda, Kampala

items.title: Qiimaha alaabta Mareykanka oo October kordhay 0.4 boqolkiiba, in ka badan intii la filayay
items.summary: Qiimaha alaabta macaamiisha ee Mareykanka ayaa bishii October kordhay 0.4 boqolkiiba marka loo eego bishii ka horreysay, halka dhaqaaleyahannadu filayeen 0.3 boqolkiiba, sida ay muujisay xog uu Talaadadii soo saaray Xafiiska Tirakoobka Shaqada (BLS).
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Postal Square ee Washington, D.C., oo ay ku taal xarunta Xafiiska Tirakoobka Shaqada ee Mareykanka

items.title: Hegseth oo isku dayga xil ka qaadistiisa ku tilmaamay jees-jees iyo carqaladeyn
items.summary: Wasiirka Difaaca Mareykanka, Pete Hegseth, ayaa Talaadadii shir jaraa'id ku sheegay in qaraarka xil ka qaadistiisa ee Golaha Wakiillada uu yahay jees-jees iyo ciyaar siyaasadeed, isagoo dhaliisha loo jeediyay iyo dagaalka Iran ku tilmaamay khilaaf siyaasadeed, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Wasiirka Difaaca Mareykanka Pete Hegseth

items.title: OCHA: Qorshaha gargaarka Soomaaliya ee 2026 waxaa loo helay 300 milyan oo dollar, oo ah 35.2% kaliya
items.summary: Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee isku-duwidda arrimaha bani'aadannimada (OCHA) ayaa sheegay in qorshaha gurmadka bani'aadannimo ee Soomaaliya ee sannadka 2026 loo helay ilaa 300 milyan oo dollar, taas oo ah 35.2 boqolkiiba lacagta loo baahan yahay, sida ay werisay Goobjoog News.
items.imageAlt: Haween Soomaaliyeed oo safka u taagan si ay u helaan baaritaan caafimaad oo bilaash ah, xero barakacayaal oo ku taal Muqdisho

items.title: Usman Khawaja oo sheegay in xubin MCC ah ay cunsuriyad ula dhaqantay Lord's sannadkii 2023
items.summary: Ciyaaryahankii hore ee kubadda cricket-ka Australia, Usman Khawaja, ayaa buuggiisa cusub ee taariikh nololeedka ku sheegay in xubin ka tirsan naadiga Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC) ay si cunsuriyad ah u caayday intii lagu jiray ciyaartii Ashes ee Lord's sannadkii 2023, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Pavilion ee garoonka cricket-ka Lord's ee London

items.title: Anthropic oo qorsheyneysa inay ilaa $64 bilyan ka ururiso suuqa saamiyada Nasdaq
items.summary: Shirkadda sirdoonka macmalka ah ee Anthropic, oo samaysay barnaamijka Claude, ayaa sheegtay inay saamiyadeeda ku iibin doonto inta u dhexeysa $70 iyo $78 halkii saami marka ay ku biirto suuqa saamiyada Nasdaq ee New York, iyadoo ku ururin karta ilaa $64 bilyan, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Nasdaq MarketSite ee magaalada New York

items.title: Baarlamaanka cusub ee Israa'iil oo la dhaariyay, Eisenkot oo isku dayaya dhisidda dowlad
items.summary: Xildhibaannada cusub ee Knesset-ka Israa'iil ayaa Talaadadii la dhaariyay, iyadoo hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka Gadi Eisenkot uu isku dayayo inuu dhiso dowlad xukunka kaga tuurta ra'iisul wasaare ku-simaha Benjamin Netanyahu, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Knesset-ka, baarlamaanka Israa'iil, ee Qudus

items.title: Wasiir Daahir Shire oo Beledweyne ka sheegay in dowladdu dareensan tahay tabashada reer Hiiraan
items.summary: Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Macdanta Soomaaliya, Daahir Shire Maxamed, oo hoggaaminaya wafdi maanta gaaray Beledweyne, ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalku dareensan tahay tabashada dadka gobolka Hiiraan oo ay ka qayb qaadan doonto xalkeeda, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Beledweyne ee gobolka Hiiraan

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo soo dhoweysay 171 muwaadin oo laga soo celiyay Liibiya
items.summary: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta soo dhoweysay 171 muwaadin oo dalka dib loogu soo celiyay kadib markii ay horey ugu tahriibeen Liibiya, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Aadan Cadde ee Muqdisho

items.title: Safiirka Turkiga iyo La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka oo ka wada hadlay iskaashiga milatari iyo amniga
items.summary: Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka, Aweys Xaaji Yuusuf Axmed, waxayna ka wada hadleen iskaashiga milatari iyo amni ee labada dal iyo la dagaallanka argagixisada, sida ay sheegtay safaaradda Turkiga.
items.imageAlt: Saldhigga milatari ee Turkiga ee magaalada Muqdisho

items.title: Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran: Laba markab oo saliid qaada ayaa dab ku qabsaday Marinka Hormuz
items.summary: Ciidamada badda ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa sheegay in Talaadadii laba markab oo saliid qaada ay dab ku qabsaday Marinka Hormuz, kaddib qarax ka dhacay waddo aysan Iran oggolaan.
items.imageAlt: Marinka Hormuz oo laga arkayo diyaarad

items.title: Qiimaha saliidda Brent oo markii ugu horreysay tan iyo August ka hooseeyay 90 doolar
items.summary: Saliidda Brent ayaa Talaadadii hoos ugu dhacday in ka yar 90 doolar fuustii, markii ugu horreysay tan iyo August, kaddib markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu tilmaamay in dagaalka Iran uu dhammaan karo, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Goob saliid laga soo saaro oo ku taal Badda Waqooyi

items.title: Maxkamad Malaysia oo u oggolaatay in Najib Razak loo wareejiyo xabsi guri
items.summary: Maxkamadda Sare ee Kuala Lumpur ayaa go'aamisay in ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee Malaysia Najib Razak, oo 73 jir ah, uu inta ka hartay xukunkiisa la dhimay ee 6 sano ah ku qaato xabsi guri, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Najib Razak, ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee Malaysia, sannadkii 2017

items.title: RC Lens oo xilka ka qaadday tababare Yannick Cahuzac 2 bilood kaddib magacaabistiisa
items.summary: Kooxda Lens ee horyaalka Faransiiska ayaa Talaadadii xilka ka qaadday tababaraheeda Yannick Cahuzac, kaddib toddobaad ay 3 jeer isku xigta ku guuldarreysatay, sida ay wariyeen L'Équipe iyo RMC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Yannick Cahuzac sannadkii 2019

items.title: Japan oo Filibiin siinaysa radar xeebeed iyo diyaarado drone ah oo qiimahoodu yahay 4.3 bilyan yen
items.summary: Japan iyo Filibiin ayaa Manila ku saxiixay heshiis deeq ah oo 4.3 bilyan yen (24 milyan euro) ah, kaas oo Japan ay ku siinayso ciidamada Filibiin nidaam radar xeebeed ah iyo diyaarado drone ah oo lagu kormeero maraakiibta, sida ay werisay Euronews.
items.imageAlt: Markabka dagaal ee BRP Miguel Malvar ee ciidamada badda Filibiin

items.title: Bulgaria: Ugu yaraan 11 qof oo ku dhintay shil baabuur badan oo meel u dhow Yambol
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 11 qof ayaa ku dhintay, 48 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen shil ay ku lug lahaayeen baabuur badan oo ka dhacay waddada weyn ee Trakia meel u dhow magaalada Yambol ee Bulgaria, sida uu sheegay Ra'iisul Wasaare Rumen Radev.
items.imageAlt: Waddada weyn ee Trakia ee Bulgaria

items.title: Uganda oo bilaabaysa barnaamij qaran oo tababar degdeg ah oo lagu daryeelayo dadka dhaawacma
items.summary: Barnaamij qaran oo shaqaalaha caafimaadka, shaqaalaha ambalaasta iyo shacabka caadiga ah lagu barayo sida loo gurmado dadka dhaawacma ayaa laga bilaabayaa Uganda, si loo yareeyo dhimashada laga hortagi karo, sida ay werisay Nile Post.
items.imageAlt: Ambalaas ka shaqeynaysa magaalada Kampala

items.title: Iran oo beenisay wadahadal la qorsheeyay, kaddib markii Trump sheegay in dagaalka ciidan uu 'ku dhowaad dhammaaday'
items.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in dagaalka Iran uu dhinaca militariga ka 'ku dhowaad dhammaaday', halka saraakiisha Iran ay beeniyeen warar sheegaya wadahadal la qorsheeyay oo Qatar lagu qabanayo, sida ay werisay Euronews.
items.imageAlt: Abbas Araghchi oo ku sugan kulan lagu qabtay Vienna (2021)

items.title: Lix dal iyo shirkado ay ka mid yihiin Anthropic, OpenAI iyo Microsoft oo saxiixay 'Baaqa Paris' ee amniga AI
items.summary: Madaxda Bahrain, Canada, Finland, Faransiiska, Norway iyo Netherlands iyo madaxda 10 shirkadood oo AI ah ayaa 9-ka November saxiixay baaq wadajir ah oo loogu magac daray 'Paris Call for AI Safety and Security', sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Qasriga Élysée ee Paris, xarunta Madaxtooyada Faransiiska

items.title: Madaxweyne Samia oo u ambabaxday Antalya si ay uga qeyb gasho shirka cimilada COP31
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa u safartay Antalya ee Türkiye si ay uga qeyb gasho shirka COP31 iyo kulan heer sare ah oo ku saabsan cunto-karinta nadiifka ah ee Afrika, sida ay werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.
items.imageAlt: Samia Suluhu Hassan (2017)

items.title: Mandera: 8 qof oo lagu dilay weerar lagu qaaday gaari ilaalinayay shaqaalaha waddada Arabia
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 8 qof ayaa lagu dilay weerar gaadmo ah oo hubeysteyaal ku qaadeen gaari amni oo ilaalinayay shaqaalaha mashruuca waddada Mandera–Arabia–Lafey, sida ay werisay The Standard iyo warbaahin kale oo Kenya ah.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Mandera ee waqooyi-bari Kenya

items.title: Askar ka tirsan beesha Xawaadle oo ka baxay ciidamada dowladda kaddib baaqii Ugaaska beesha
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 300 oo askari oo ka tirsan beesha Xawaadle ayaa labadii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay ka baxay safka ciidamada dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, kaddib baaq uu soo saaray Ugaaska guud ee beesha, sida ay werisay Radio Daljir.
items.imageAlt: Gaari ay saaran yihiin askar ka tirsan ciidamada xoogga dalka Soomaaliya oo dhex maraya magaalada Beledweyne (sawir hore, 2012)

items.title: Hindiya: 3 shaqaale oo ku dhintay warshadda qaybaha iPhone ee Tata ee Hosur
items.summary: Saddex shaqaale qandaraas ah ayaa ku dhintay warshadda Tata Electronics ee Hosur, gobolka Tamil Nadu, kaddib markii ay neefsadeen gaas intii ay baarayeen haan biyo-sifeyn, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Qorrax-soo-baxa magaalada Hosur ee gobolka Tamil Nadu, Hindiya

items.title: Isbaanish: Sarkaal booliis ah oo ku dhintay qarax boorso ka dhacay magaalada Oviedo
items.summary: Sarkaal ka tirsan Booliska Qaranka Isbaanish ayaa ku dhintay, mid kalena si xun ayuu u dhaawacmay, kaddib markii boorso dhabarka la saarto ay ku qaraxday dhisme ku yaal magaalada Oviedo, sida ay werisay BBC iyo warbaahinta Isbaanish.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal ka mid ah magaalada Oviedo ee Isbaanish

items.title: Uganda: Golaha Wasiirada oo ansixiyay 19 bilyan oo shilin oo loogu talagalay 1,841 ganacsade oo fatahaaddu saameysay
items.summary: Golaha Wasiirada Uganda ayaa ansixiyay 18.9995 bilyan oo shilin oo gargaar ah oo la siinayo 1,841 ganacsade oo la xaqiijiyay kuwaas oo ganacsigoodu ku waxyeelloobay fatahaaddii Kampala ee October 2025, sida ay werisay Nile Post.
items.imageAlt: Suuqa St. Balikuddembe (Owino) ee magaalada Kampala

items.title: Franziska Liebhardt, oo dahab ku qaadatay Paralympics-kii Rio 2016, oo ku geeriyootay da'da 44
items.summary: Ciyaartoyda Jarmalka Franziska Liebhardt, oo ku guuleysatay billad dahab ah oo tuurista culeyska ah iyo billad lacag ah oo boodka dheer ah Paralympics-kii Rio 2016, ayaa ku geeriyootay da'da 44, sida ay werisay kicker.
items.imageAlt: Franziska Liebhardt (2012)

items.title: Mareykanka oo diyaarado ka raray saldhigga RAF Mildenhall ee Ingiriiska kaddib hanjabaad Iran
items.summary: Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii diyaarado shidaal-ku-shubid ah ka raray saldhigga cirka ee RAF Mildenhall ee bariga England kaddib hanjabaad laga sheegay Iran, sida uu werinayo wargeyska The Wall Street Journal.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarad shidaal-ku-shubid ah oo KC-135 ah oo ku sugan saldhigga RAF Mildenhall

items.title: Kenya: Maxkamadda Heerka Sare oo 1-da December dhageysan doonta dacwad cusub oo ka dhan ah golaha wasiirada Ruto
items.summary: Maxkamadda Heerka Sare ee Kenya ayaa degdeg u aqoonsatay codsi lagu doonayo in la hakiyo golaha wasiirada, iyadoo ururro bulsho ay sheegeen in Madaxweyne William Ruto uusan fulin amar maxkamadeed oo ku saabsan dib-u-dhiska golaha.
items.imageAlt: William Ruto oo hadal ka jeedinaya shirka IAEA ee Vienna (2010)

items.title: beIN Sports oo raalligelin bixisay kaddib hadal takoorid jinsi ah oo tebinta lagu maqlay oo ku saabsan Sabalenka
items.summary: Telefishinka beIN Sports ayaa raalligelin bixiyay kaddib markii mid ka mid ah faallo-bixiyayaashiisa, oo u maleynayay inaan la tebinayn, hadal xun ka yiri Aryna Sabalenka ka hor ciyaarteedii WTA Finals, sida ay RMC Sport werisay.
items.imageAlt: Aryna Sabalenka oo ku jirta tartanka Miami Open 2025

items.title: Cilmi-baaris: qiiqa shidaalka dhulka ka baxa oo markii ugu horreysay tan iyo Covid hoos u dhacaya
items.summary: Qiiqa kaarboonka ee ka dhasha gubashada saliidda, gaaska iyo dhuxusha ayaa la filayaa inuu sanadkan 2026 hoos u dhaco 0.4 boqolkiiba, sida ay sheegtay warbixinta sanadlaha ah ee Global Carbon Budget.
items.imageAlt: Tuubooyinka qiiqa ee warshadda korontada dhuxusha ee Edwards, gobolka Illinois ee Mareykanka

items.title: Golaha Amaanka ee QM oo maanta warbixin ka dhageysanaya xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Suudaan
items.summary: Golaha Amaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Talaadadan yeelanaya kulan furan oo looga hadlayo xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Suudaan, sida ay Eye Radio werisay.
items.imageAlt: Qolka shirarka Golaha Amaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ee xarunta New York

items.title: Tartanka Behobia-San Sebastián: 853 orodyahan oo la reebay kaddib markii ay waqtigoodii ka hor bilaabeen
items.summary: Qabanqaabiyayaasha tartanka orodka 20 kiilomitir ee Behobia-San Sebastián ee dalka Basque ayaa buriyay natiijooyinka 853 orodyahan oo ka bilaabay koox ka horreysa tii loo qoondeeyay, sida ay RMC Sport iyo Diario Vasco werisay.
items.imageAlt: Orodyahanno ka qayb galaya tartanka Behobia-San Sebastián ee 2023

items.title: Wadahadallada Ukraine, Ruushka iyo Mareykanka oo Abu Dhabi dib uga bilaabmay kaddib 9 bilood oo hakad ah
items.summary: Wafuud ka socda Ukraine, Ruushka iyo Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadan Abu Dhabi ku yeelanaya wareeggii ugu horreeyay ee wadahadallo tan iyo February, iyadoo wakiillo Yurub ah ay magaalada kula kulmayaan dhinaca Ukraine, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today oo soo xigatay AFP.
items.imageAlt: Rustem Umerov, madaxa wafdiga wadahadallada Ukraine

items.title: Mbappé oo loo doortay ciyaaryahanka bisha October ee LaLiga, isagoo ka horreeyay Lamine Yamal
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Real Madrid Kylian Mbappé ayaa LaLiga u doortay ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican bishii October kaddib markii uu 4 gool ku dhaliyay 3 kulan, sida ay werisay RMC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Kylian Mbappé oo u ciyaaraya Real Madrid (2025)

items.title: Trump: Weerar cusub oo lagu qaado Iran wuxuu noqon lahaa ku dhowaad shan jibbaar kii hore
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Isniintii sheegay in weerar cusub oo lagu qaado Iran uu noqon lahaa qiyaastii shan jibbaar kii ugu horreeyay, balse uu dib u dhigayo codsi ka yimid Qatar, Sacuudiga iyo dalal kale oo Khaliijka ah, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.
items.imageAlt: Donald Trump oo la kulmaya Amiirka Qatar iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani (2025)

items.title: Ruto oo daah-furay waddo 1.3 bilyan oo shilin ah oo Bonchari, kuna dhawaaqay qorshe waddooyin 22 bilyan ah
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa degmada Bonchari ka daah-furay mashruuc waddo oo ku kacaya 1.3 bilyan oo shilin, wuxuuna ku dhawaaqay 22 bilyan oo shilin oo loogu talagalay dhismaha iyo dayactirka waddooyinka gobollada Kisii iyo Nyamira, sida ay werisay Capital FM.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto oo ku sugan Aqalka Madaxtooyada ee Nairobi (2023)

items.title: Maxkamad Jarmal ah oo taageertay kala noqoshada magangelyada haweeney Soomaaliyeed oo booqatay Somaliland
items.summary: Maxkamadda Maamulka ee magaalada Trier ee Jarmalka ayaa diidday racfaan ay qaadatay haweeney Soomaaliyeed oo ku nool Mainz, waxayna taageertay go'aanka hay'adda socdaalka BAMF ee lagaga noqday aqoonsigeeda qaxootinimo, kaddib markii muuqaallo ay TikTok soo dhigtay ay muujiyeen inay dhowr jeer booqatay Somaliland, sida…
items.imageAlt: Albaabka Maxkamadda Maamulka ee magaalada Trier, Jarmalka

items.title: Qoraaga Ingiriiska M. John Harrison oo 81 jir ah ayaa ku guuleystay Abaalmarinta Booker
items.summary: M. John Harrison ayaa noqday qofka ugu da'da weyn ee abid ku guuleysta Abaalmarinta Booker, isagoo buuggiisa "The End of Everything" ku helay abaalmarinta 2026 ee £50,000, sida ay Türkiye Today werisay.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Old Billingsgate ee London, halkaas oo lagu qabtay xafladda Booker

items.title: Rubucda caalamka oo ku heshiisay inay fududeeyaan wada-hadallada doorashada Soomaaliya
items.summary: Maraykanka, Britain, Turkiga iyo Midowga Yurub ayaa isku raacay inay fududeeyaan wada-hadallada doorashooyinka ee u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka, kuwaas oo la qorsheeyay 14-ka ilaa 18-ka November, sida ay Hiiraan Online sheegtay.
items.imageAlt: Siyaasiyiin iyo odayaal Soomaaliyeed oo ku sugan Villa Somalia ee Muqdisho, July 2014

items.title: Ramla Ali oo ku guuleysatay laba suun oo horyaalnimada feerka adduunka ah
items.summary: Feeryahannadda Soomaaliyeed Ramla Ali ayaa dhammaadkii usbuuca ku guuleysatay suumanka horyaalnimada adduunka ee WBO iyo IBF ee miisaanka super bantamweight, kaddib markii ay magaalada Arlington ee gobolka Texas go'aan kala qaybsan ku garaacday feeryahannadda Mareykanka Mikiah Kreps.
items.imageAlt: Feeryahannadda Soomaaliyeed Ramla Ali, Paris 2026

items.title: Bunny Shaw oo ka mid ah shanta u tartamaysa Ciyaaryahanadda Sanadka ee BBC 2026
items.summary: BBC ayaa furtay codbixinta Ciyaaryahanadda Kubadda Cagta Haweenka ee Sanadka 2026, iyadoo liiska kama dambaysta ah ay ku jiraan Temwa Chawinga, Ewa Pajor, Alexia Putellas, Alessia Russo iyo Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw.
items.imageAlt: Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw oo xiran funaanadda xulka Jamaica, 2019

items.title: Duqeymo cirka ah oo la sheegay inay Mareykanku ka fuliyeen degmada Qandala ee gobolka Bari
items.summary: Duqeymo cirka ah oo isdaba joog ah ayaa habeenkii Isniinta ee 9 November laga fuliyay deegaanno ka tirsan degmada Qandala ee gobolka Bari ee Puntland, kuwaas oo sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online ay fuliyeen ciidamada Mareykanka ee taageera dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Daacish.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Qandala ee xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed, gobolka Bari ee Puntland

items.title: Kenya oo si joogto ah u xiraysa safaaraddeeda Bern ee dalka Switzerland
items.summary: Safaaradda Kenya ee Bern ayaa ogeysiisay in adeegyada qunsuliyadda ay joogsanayaan 30-ka November 2026, iyadoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay sheegtay in go'aanku qayb ka yahay dib-u-habeynta xafiisyada diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka, sida ay Capital FM werisay.
items.imageAlt: Aqalka Bundeshaus ee magaalada Bern, Switzerland, oo laga arkayo webiga Aare

items.title: FIFPro World 11 ee ragga 2026: Harry Kane oo ka maqan, Messi-na markii 18aad ku jira
items.summary: Ururka FIFPro ayaa shaaciyay kooxda ugu fiican adduunka ee ragga 2026, oo ay codeeyeen 19806 ciyaartoy; Harry Kane oo dhawaan ku guuleystay Ballon d'Or kuma jiro, halka Lionel Messi uu markii 18aad ku jiro, sida ay wariyeen FIFPro iyo RMC Sport.
items.imageAlt: Harry Kane oo tababar la jira xulka England

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Cardinal Ameyu oo ugu baaqay hoggaamiyayaasha Suudaan iyo Koonfur Suudaan inay muwaadiniinta mudnaan siiyaan
items.summary: Cardinal Stephen Ameyu Martin Mulla ayaa magaalada Torit ka sheegay in hoggaamiyayaasha labada dal ay danaha shacabka ka hormariyaan hammiga siyaasadeed, isagoo ku baaqay is-afgarad iyo wadahadal, sida ay werisay Radio Tamazuj.
items.imageAlt: Cardinal Stephen Ameyu Martin Mulla

items.title: Krakow: Madaxweyne Nawrocki iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Tusk oo hoggaamiyay socod aamusan oo loogu talagalay dhibbanayaasha
items.summary: Kumanaan qof ayaa habeenkii Isniinta ku socday bartamaha Krakow iyagoo xusaya dadkii lagu dilay rasaastii Sabtidii ka dhacday Fagaaraha Suuqa Weyn, waxaana hormuud ka ahaa Madaxweyne Karol Nawrocki iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Donald Tusk, sida ay werisay BBC.
items.imageAlt: Fagaaraha Suuqa Weyn ee Krakow oo habeenkii la sawiray

items.title: Tanzania: Qareennada Tundu Lissu oo sheegay in diyaarinta racfaanka xukunka 4 sano ay kala bar marayso
items.summary: Qareennada guddoomiyaha xisbiga mucaaradka Chadema, Tundu Lissu, ayaa sheegay inay dhammeeyeen kala bar diyaarinta racfaanka xukunka 4 sano ee xabsi ah ee lagu riday dacwad kicin ah, sida ay werisay The Citizen.
items.imageAlt: Tundu Lissu, guddoomiyaha xisbiga Chadema

items.title: NBA: Wembanyama oo 40 dhibcood dhaliyay, Spurs-na 9 guul oo isku xigta gaartay
items.summary: San Antonio Spurs ayaa Isniintii Phoenix Suns kaga adkaatay 122-96, iyadoo Victor Wembanyama uu 25 daqiiqo gudahood ku dhaliyay 40 dhibcood, 11 rebound iyo 9 block, sida ay wariyeen RMC Sport iyo AP.
items.imageAlt: Victor Wembanyama oo u ciyaaraya San Antonio Spurs

items.title: Madaxa canshuuraha Koonfur Suudaan: iskaanarro ayaa shaqaalaha kastamka Nimule ka dhigi kara 50
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka Koonfur Suudaan, Rizig Dominic Samuel, ayaa sheegay in iskaanarro casri ah oo la geeyo xadka Nimule ay shaqaalaha kastamka ka dhimi karaan in ka badan 600 ilaa ku dhawaad 50, sida uu Eye Radio soo wariyay.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Juba iyo Nimule oo isku xidha Koonfur Suudaan iyo xadka Uganda

items.title: Australia oo shaacisay xeerar adag oo amniga AI ah iyo hay'ad cusub oo kormeerta
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaare Anthony Albanese ayaa ku dhawaaqay in shirkadaha AI ee ka shaqeeya Australia ay qasab ku noqon doonto inay soo sheegaan jebinta amniga, iyadoo la samaynayo hay'ad cusub oo kormeer ah, sida ay SBS iyo Sweden Herald soo wariyeen.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Australia Anthony Albanese

items.title: Faa'iidada ganacsiga Shiinaha oo dhaaftay 1 trillion oo doollar 10 bilood gudahood
items.summary: Xogta kastamka Shiinaha ayaa muujisay in faa'iidada ganacsiga dalka ee Janaayo ilaa Oktoobar ay gaartay 1.04 trillion oo doollar, iyadoo dhoofinta ay kor u kacday baahida caalamiga ah ee qalabka AI, sida ay CNN iyo AFP soo wariyeen.
items.imageAlt: Konteenarro iyo wiishash ku yaalla dekedda Yangshan ee Shanghai, Shiinaha

items.title: Codbixiyeyaasha California oo diiday canshuur hal mar ah oo la saarayo hantida bilyaneerada
items.summary: Codbixiyeyaasha gobolka California ee Mareykanka ayaa diiday Proposition 40, oo ahayd canshuur 5% ah oo hal mar lagu soo rogi lahaa hantida bilyaneerada, taasoo noqon lahayd tii ugu horreysay ee noocaas ah ee Mareykanka, sida ay France 24 soo warisay.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Capitol-ka gobolka California ee magaalada Sacramento

items.title: Isbahaysiga Sacuudiga oo sheegay inuu riday gantaallo Xuuthiyiintu ku ganeen Riyadh
items.summary: Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudi Carabiya hoggaamiyo ayaa sheegay in difaaca cirku uu burburiyay gantaal ballistic ah iyo gantaal cruise ah oo loo ganay caasimadda Riyadh, iyo gantaal kale oo loo ganay koonfurta boqortooyada, saacado kadib weerar lagu qaaday dhuumaha saliidda Bari-Galbeed.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaalka dhismayaasha dhaadheer ee waqooyiga magaalada Riyadh, Sacuudi Carabiya

items.title: Los Angeles: Diyaarad Air France ah oo leexasho khaldan ku gashay waddada diyaarad kale
items.summary: Diyaarad Air France ah oo ka duulaysay garoonka Los Angeles ayaa leexasho aan la oggolayn samaysay, taasoo dhigtay waddada diyaarad American Airlines ah oo kacaysay, sida ay sheegtay Hay'adda Duulista Mareykanka (FAA).
items.imageAlt: Diyaarad Air France ah oo nooca Airbus A350 ah oo ku sugan garoonka diyaaradaha Los Angeles

items.title: Amnesty oo El Salvador iyo Haiti ka dalbatay inay shaaciyaan heshiiska 2000 askari
items.summary: Ururka Amnesty International ayaa Isniintii ka codsaday El Salvador iyo Haiti inay soo bandhigaan heshiiska lagu dirayo qiyaastii 2000 askari oo Salvadoran ah oo loo diray Haiti, isagoo ka digay khatarta xuquuqda aadanaha, sida ay werisay France 24.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha El Salvador Nayib Bukele oo kormeeraya askarta ciidamada qalabka sida, 2019

items.summary: Weerar internet ah oo lagu qaaday nidaamka xakameynta qaboojiyeyaasha ayaa saameeyay suuqyo waaweyn oo ku yaal Beljim, Iswiidhan, Finland, Ayrlaand iyo dalal kale, taasoo keentay in cunto badan la tuuro, sida ay wariyeen Reuters iyo The Guardian. Beljim ayaa furtay baaritaan dambi, mana jiro cid si rasmi ah loo…
items.imageAlt: Qaboojiye caano oo ku jira suuq weyn (sawir muujinaya, Norway 2017)

items.title: Baarlamaanka Puntland oo kulan wadatashi ah kala yeeshay siyaasiyiin ku saabsan wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiilada Puntland Cabdirisaaq Axmed Siciid ayaa furay kulan wadatashi oo uu yeeshay guddi gaar ah oo qiimeynaya wax-ka-beddelka la soo jeediyay ee dastuurka Puntland, sida ay Horseed Media sheegtay. Mas'uuliyiin hore oo Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka ka soo shaqeeyay ayaa ka qeyb galay oo soo…
items.imageAlt: Cabdirisaaq Axmed Siciid, guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiilada Puntland

items.title: NBA: Gilgeous-Alexander oo 43 dhibcood dhaliyay, Thunder-na 117-112 kaga adkaatay Cavaliers
items.summary: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander ayaa dhaliyay 43 dhibcood oo ah kiisii ugu badnaa xilli ciyaareedkan, isagoo Oklahoma City Thunder ka caawiyay guul ay ka gaartay Cleveland Cavaliers. Donovan Mitchell ayaa Cavaliers u dhaliyay 17 dhibcood iyo 11 caawin, sida ay GMA News iyo TSN wariyeen.
items.imageAlt: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander oo u ciyaaraya Oklahoma City Thunder (2022)

items.title: Everton oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Newcastle garoonka St James' Park
items.summary: Thierno Barry ayaa dhaliyay goolka kaliya ee ciyaarta daqiiqadii 49-aad, halka Jacob Ramsey oo Newcastle ah laga saaray garoonka waqtiga dheeraadka ah kadib laba kaar oo jaalle ah. Natiijada waxaa xaqiijiyay ESPN iyo beIN SPORTS.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka St James' Park ee magaalada Newcastle

items.title: Jaamacadda Carabta oo cambaareysay safiirka Israa'iil ee Somaliland iyo safaaradda Hargeysa
items.summary: Xoghayaha Guud ee Jaamacadda Carabta, Naabiil Fahmi, ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyinkan aysan sharciyad lahayn oo ay xadgudub ku yihiin madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada Soomaaliya, sida uu werisay Hiiraan Online. Jaamacaddu waxay ku celisay inay diidan tahay xiriir kasta oo rasmi ah ama aan rasmi ahayn oo lala yeesho…
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Jaamacadda Carabta ee magaalada Qaahira

items.title: Mareykanka oo Koonfur Afrika iyo Rwanda ka hakinaya ganacsiga canshuur la'aanta ah ee AGOA
items.summary: Ergayga Ganacsiga Mareykanka Jamieson Greer ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Koonfur Afrika iyo Rwanda laga hakinayo barnaamijka AGOA laga bilaabo 1 Janaayo 2027, isagoo sheegay in labada dal aysan buuxin shuruudaha. Koonfur Afrika ayaa sannadkii 2025 barnaamijkan ku dhoofisay alaab qiimaheedu yahay ku dhawaad $1.7 bilyan, sida…
items.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Ergayga Ganacsiga Mareykanka Jamieson Greer (2025)

items.title: Iiraan oo sheegtay in qorsheheeda xabbad-joojinta ee Mareykanka la dedejin karo
items.summary: Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan Esmaeil Baghaei ayaa sheegay in qorshaha xabbad-joojinta ee Iiraan u soo jeedisay Mareykanka hadda lagu fulin karo laba maalmood halkii toddoba, kaasoo ay ku jirto dib u furidda Marinka Hormuz. Iiraan ayaa ku adkaysatay in Mareykanku qaado xannibaadda badda iyo…
items.imageAlt: Abbas Araghchi, hadda wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Iiraan, oo booqasho ku jooga IAEA (2021)

items.title: Jarmalka: Ururka IG Metall oo bilaabay shaqo-joojinno mushaar kordhin ah
items.summary: Ururka shaqaalaha ee IG Metall ayaa bilaabay shaqo-joojinno ka dhacay shirkadaha sida Audi iyo Mercedes-Benz, isagoo dalbanaya kororka mushaarka 5% ee ku dhawaad 3.7 milyan oo shaqaale ah. Ururka ayaa diiday dalabka loo-shaqeeyayaasha oo uu ku tilmaamay mushaar dhimis dhab ah, sida ay Al Jazeera iyo Reuters wariyeen.
items.imageAlt: Shaqaale ka tirsan ururka IG Metall oo shaqo-joojin digniin ah ku sameynaya magaalada Witten ee Jarmalka (2012)

items.title: Hindiya oo sheegtay inay xorreysay markabka kalluumeysiga Azini oo laga afduubay xeebaha Bari
items.summary: Dowladda Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadeeda badda iyo cirka ay hawlgal 48 saac ah oo Badweynta Hindiya ka dhacay ku xorreeyeen markabka kalluumeysiga Azini oo calanka Iiraan wata iyo 20 shaqaale ah oo saarnaa, sida ay Horseed Media wariyay. Markabka ayaa la sheegay in la afduubay 29 Oktoobar inta u dhaxaysa Bandar…
items.imageAlt: Markabka dagaalka ee ciidamada badda Hindiya INS Betwa oo ku xiran dekedda Mumbai (2009)

items.title: Ukraine: 24 qof oo ku dhintay duqeyn lagu qaaday xarun gargaar oo ku taal gobolka Zaporizhzhia
items.summary: Hay'adda gurmadka degdegga ah ee Ukraine ayaa sheegtay in 24 qof ay ku dhinteen duqeyn Ruushka lagu eedeeyay oo ku dhacday iskuul loo isticmaali jiray xarun gargaar oo ku yaal tuulada Komyshuvakha. Madaxweyne Zelenskyy ayaa cambaareeyay weerarka, halka Ruushka uu horay u beeniyay inuu bartilmaameedsado dadka rayidka…
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha iskuulka muusikada ee tuulada Komyshuvakha, gobolka Zaporizhzhia (2025)

items.title: Faransiiska: dibadbaxyada ardayda dugsiyada sare oo dib u bilowday, balse si yar
items.summary: Ardayda dugsiyada sare ee Faransiiska ayaa dib u bilaabay dibadbaxyadii kadib fasax laba toddobaad ah, balse Wasaaradda Waxbarashadu waxay sheegtay in Isniintii 41 dugsi oo keliya la xiray, halkii toddobaadyadii hore boqollaal la xiri jiray, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Arday xiray albaabka dugsiga sare ee Buffon ee Paris, Desembar 2024

items.title: Abdullah Öcalan oo loo wareejiyay qayb cusub oo ka mid ah xabsiga jasiiradda İmralı
items.summary: Turkiga ayaa Abdullah Öcalan, aasaasihii xisbiga PKK ee xiran, u wareejiyay qayb cusub oo laga dhisay xabsiga jasiiradda İmralı, sida ay sheegeen xildhibaanno ka tirsan xisbiga DEM, ayuu yiri Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Jasiiradda İmralı oo laga sawiray diyaarad

items.title: Maxkamad Brooklyn ku taal oo bilaabaysa dacwadda laba ciyaaryahan oo MLB ah oo lagu eedeeyay khamaar
items.summary: Emmanuel Clase iyo Luis Ortiz oo hore ugu ciyaari jiray Cleveland Guardians ayaa maxkamad federaal oo ku taal Brooklyn ka wajahaya dacwad ay xeer-ilaaliyayaashu ku eedeeyeen inay lacag ka qaateen laba khamaarle, waxayna labaduba ku doodeen inaysan dambi gelin, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera oo xiganaya AP.
items.imageAlt: Maxkamadda federaalka ee Brooklyn, New York

items.title: Telefishinka dowladda Shiinaha oo sii wada joojinta ciyaaraha Real Madrid kadib muranka Mbappé
items.summary: Labada kanaal ee isboortiga CCTV ma aysan baahin guushii 3-0 ee Real Madrid ay Axaddii ka gaartay Racing Santander, iyadoo muranka ka dhashay muuqaal Kylian Mbappé uu ku hadlay Mao Zedong uu weli socdo, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera oo xiganaya AFP.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Santiago Bernabéu ee kooxda Real Madrid

items.title: Bangladesh: dibadbaxyada shaqaalaha warshadaha dharka oo maalintii saddexaad socda
items.summary: Boqollaal warshadood oo dhar ah oo Bangladesh ku yaal ayaa hawshoodu carqaladowday iyadoo shaqaaluhu ay ka dibadbaxayaan mushahar yar iyo qaali noqoshada nolosha, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Haween ka shaqeeya warshad dhar oo ku taal Bangladesh

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Hebron oo sheegay in ciidamada Israa'iil ka baxeen magaalada kadib 10 maalmood oo go'doomin ah
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Hebron Khaled Dudin ayaa Isniintii sheegay in ciidamada Israa'iil ay ka baxeen magaalada ku taal Daanta Galbeed kadib go'doomin socotay 10 maalmood, ciidamada amniga Falastiinna ayaa la wareegay deegaanka, sida uu sheegay Al Jazeera.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada qadiimiga ah ee Hebron

items.title: NBA: Yaxel Lendeborg oo 37 dhibcood dhaliyay, Warriors-na 124-112 kaga adkaatay Clippers
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka sannadkiisa koowaad ee Golden State Warriors Yaxel Lendeborg ayaa dhaliyay 37 dhibcood, waana tirada ugu badan ee ciyaaryahan cusub oo Warriors ah dhaliyo tan iyo Stephen Curry 2010, sida ay ESPN sheegtay.
items.imageAlt: Yaxel Lendeborg oo u ciyaaraya Michigan, Febraayo 2026

items.title: Puntland oo diiwaangelinaysa ciidamo ay Mareykanku ku tababarayaan saldhig ku yaal Boosaaso
items.summary: Maamulka Puntland ayaa bilaabay diiwaangelinta ku dhawaad 100 askari oo ka kala socda cutubyo amni oo kala duwan, kuwaas oo Mareykanku ku tababari doono saldhig ciidan oo ku yaal Boosaaso, sida uu sheegay Garowe Online oo xiganaya warbaahinta maxalliga ah.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Boosaaso ah

items.title: Kimi Antonelli oo noqday horyaalka adduunka ee ugu da’da yar taariikhda Formula 1
items.summary: Darawalka Mercedes Kimi Antonelli oo 20 jir ah ayaa kaalinta 3-aad ka galay Mexico City Grand Prix, wuxuuna ku guuleystay horyaalnimada darawallada, halka Max Verstappen uu ku guuleystay tartanka, sida ay FIA sheegtay.
items.imageAlt: Kimi Antonelli oo dabaaldegaya kadib tartankii China Grand Prix (2026)

items.title: Serie A: Juventus oo 2-0 garaacday Napoli, Lazio oo kaalinta koowaad qabsatay
items.summary: Juventus ayaa 2-0 kaga adkaatay Napoli oo 10 ciyaartoy ku dhammeysatay, halka Lazio oo 2-1 garaacday Cagliari ay markii ugu horreysay 16 sano kadib hoggaanka Serie A qabsatay, sida ay Football Italia ku warantay.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Juventus (Allianz Stadium) ee magaalada Turin, Talyaaniga

items.title: Baarlamaanka Carabta oo cambaareeyay weerarkii markabka gaaska ee Qatar
items.summary: Baarlamaanka Carabta ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay bartilmaameedsiga markabka gaaska dareeraha ah (LNG) ee Al Mayeda ee Qatar, intii uu marayay Gacanka Carabta, wuxuuna ka digay in weerarradaas ay khatar ku yihiin amniga gobolka iyo sahayda tamarta, sida ay SONNA ku warantay.
items.imageAlt: Markabka gaaska dareeraha ah ee Mozah oo ay leedahay shirkadda Qatar ee Nakilat, dekedda Ras Laffan (2010)

items.title: Isbitaalka Erdogan ee Muqdisho oo keenay qalab casri ah oo lagu ogaado kansarka
items.summary: Isbitaalka Recep Tayyip Erdogan (Digfeer) ee Muqdisho ayaa qaybtiisa baaritaanka unugyada ku daray saddex mashiin oo markii ugu horreysay la keenay Soomaaliya, sida uu Dawan Africa u sheegay madaxa qaybta, Dr. Ismaaciil Maxamuud Cabdullaahi.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Isbitaalka Recep Tayyip Erdogan ee Muqdisho (2015)

items.title: Premier League: Arsenal oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Liverpool, hoggaankana qabsatay
items.summary: Gool uu Kai Havertz dhaliyay daqiiqadii 16-aad ayaa Arsenal u horseeday guushii ugu horreysay ee ay Anfield ka gaarto 14 sano gudahood, waxayna u gudubtay kaalinta koowaad ee Premier League, sida ay AP ku warantay.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Anfield ee kooxda Liverpool oo laga muuqaal qaaday safka weyn

items.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Hamburger SV
items.summary: Eintracht Frankfurt ayaa 3-1 ku garaacday Hamburger SV, waxayna u dalacday kaalinta 8-aad ee Bundesliga, sida ay Bulinews iyo IANS ku warrameen.
items.imageAlt: Ciyaar Eintracht Frankfurt ku dhex martay garoonkeeda Waldstadion (Deutsche Bank Park), 2024

items.title: LaLiga: Real Madrid oo 3-0 kaga adkaatay Racing Santander
items.summary: Real Madrid ayaa qeybtii hore saddex gool ku dhalisay garoonka Racing Santander, waxayna gaartay guushii lixaad oo isku xigta, sida ay muujiyeen warbixinnada kooxda iyo ESPN.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka El Sardinero ee magaalada Santander, Isbaanish

items.title: SomBank iyo IBS Bank oo maalgelin Islaami ah u fidiyay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed
items.summary: SomBank ayaa sheegtay inay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed siisay maalgelin Islaami ah oo gaareysa ilaa $2 milyan, halka IBS Bank ay soo bandhigtay adeeg cusub oo lagu magacaabo “Kalluun Kaabe”, sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay.
items.imageAlt: Laba kalluumeysato Soomaaliyeed oo ku sugan magaalada Baraawe

items.title: Barnaamijka Saudi Noor oo Muqdisho ka bilaabay daaweyn iyo qalliin bilaash ah oo indhaha
items.summary: Barnaamijka bani’aadminnimo ee Saudi Noor 2026 ayaa Isbitaalka Madiina ee Muqdisho ka bilaabay adeegyo bilaash ah oo daryeelka indhaha, kuwaas oo lagu wado inay gaaraan ku dhawaad 500 bukaan, sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay.
items.imageAlt: Dhakhtar ku jira qaybta gurmadka ee Isbitaalka Madiina, Muqdisho (2014)

items.title: Ligue 1: Marseille oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Toulouse garoonka Vélodrome
items.summary: Olympique de Marseille ayaa 2-0 ku garaacday Toulouse ciyaar ka tirsan wareegga 9-aad ee Ligue 1, sida ay Foot Mercato ku warantay.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Vélodrome ee kooxda Olympique de Marseille

items.title: Shirka COP17 oo Yerevan ku ansixiyay qorshe lagu dardargelinayo ilaalinta dabeecadda
items.summary: Dalalka ka qeybgalay Shirka QM ee Kala-duwanaanshaha Noolaha (COP17) ee caasimadda Armenia ayaa ku heshiiyay “Yerevan Pathway”, oo ah qorshe lagu dardargelinayo 23-ka hadaf ee la doonayo in la gaaro 2030, sida ay UN News ku warantay.
items.imageAlt: Albaabka xarunta Shirka QM ee Kala-duwanaanshaha Noolaha (COP17) ee Yerevan, Armenia

items.title: Mo Ibrahim: Dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha Afrika waa hoos u dhacayaan
items.summary: Mo Ibrahim, aasaasaha hay’adda Mo Ibrahim Foundation, ayaa wakaaladda AFP u sheegay in dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha ay Afrika hoos ugu dhacayaan. Tusmada hay’addu waxay muujisay horumar dhaqaale, balse hoos u dhac xagga amniga iyo ka qeybgalka dadweynaha.
items.imageAlt: Mo Ibrahim oo khudbad ka jeedinaya shir ka dhacay Uppsala, Iswiidhan (2014)

items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga safiirka Israa’iil
items.summary: Sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay, Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ayaa Axaddii qasriga madaxtooyada ee Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga Michael Lotem, oo ah safiirka Israa’iil u fadhiya Somaliland.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Cirro oo Hargeysa kula hadlaya taliyaha AFRICOM, Gen. Dagvin Anderson (Nofeembar 2025)

items.title: Hawlgalkii QM ee Saxaraha Galbeed (MINURSO) oo dhammaaday kadib 35 sano
items.summary: Muddada hawlgalka MINURSO ayaa dhammaatay saqdii dhexe ee Sabtida kadib markii Golaha Ammaanka uu ku heshiin waayay mustaqbalkiisa. Xoghayaha Guud António Guterres ayaa sheegay in QM ay diyaar u tahay inay sii taageerto dadaallada nabadda, sida ay UN News ku warantay.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta hawlgalka MINURSO ee magaalada Laayoune (2012)

items.title: Boosaaso oo lagu qabtay tartankii ugu horreeyay ee kubadda cagta xeebta Soomaaliya
items.summary: Sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay, Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Puntland iyo Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya ayaa 30 Oktoobar Boosaaso ka furay tartan kubadda cagta xeebta ah oo ay ka qayb galayaan 6 kooxood, kaas oo markii ugu horreysay ay haweenku ka muuqdaan.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Boosaaso iyo xeebteeda oo hawada laga sawiray (2024)

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qayb gashay furitaanka Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026
items.summary: Calanka Soomaaliya ayaa ka mid ahaa kuwa lagu soo bandhigay furitaanka Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026, oo socon doona 31 Oktoobar ilaa 13 Nofembar. Soomaaliya waxaa matalaya feeryahanka 17 jirka ah Xasan Anwar oo ku tartamaya miisaanka 50 kiilo.
items.imageAlt: Damaashaadka toosha Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada Dakar 2026 ee Diamniadio

items.title: Golden State Valkyries oo ku guuleystay horyaalkii ugu horreeyay ee WNBA
items.summary: Sida ay wakaaladda AP ku warantay, Golden State Valkyries ayaa ciyaartii 7aad ee finalka WNBA ku garaacday Atlanta Dream 68-63, waxayna qaadeen horyaalkoodii ugu horreeyay, iyagoo ku jira xilli-ciyaareedkoodii 2aad oo keliya.
items.imageAlt: Golden State Valkyries oo la ciyaaraya Indiana Fever (May 2026)

items.title: Lewis Hamilton oo ka bilaabaya safka hore Mexico City Grand Prix
items.summary: Sida ay Sky Sports ku warantay, Lewis Hamilton ayaa markii ugu horreysay isagoo u tartamaya Ferrari ku guuleystay booska koowaad ee bilowga (pole) ee Mexico City Grand Prix, isagoo ka horreeyay George Russell iyo Charles Leclerc.
items.imageAlt: Lewis Hamilton oo baabuurka Ferrari wata (2025)

items.title: Canelo Álvarez oo dib u qaatay suunka WBC ee miisaanka super-middleweight
items.summary: Sida ay Sky Sports ku warantay, feeryahanka reer Mexico Canelo Álvarez ayaa magaalada Riyadh go’aan ay garsoorayaasha oo dhammi isku raaceen kaga adkaaday Christian Mbilli, oo ahaa horyaal aan weli laga badin, wuxuuna dib ula noqday suunka WBC.
items.imageAlt: Canelo Álvarez oo feeraha ku jira (sawir hore, 2017)

items.title: Nigeria oo baaraysa laba kiis oo looga shakiyay Ebola
items.summary: Sida ay Al Jazeera ku warantay, Xarunta Nigeria ee La-dagaallanka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada (NCDC) ayaa sheegtay in waqooyi-bari dalka laga helay laba qof oo looga shakiyay Ebola; waa la go’doomiyay, baaritaan shaybaarna waa lagu wadaa.
items.imageAlt: Fayraska Ebola oo mikroskoob lagu sawiray

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo baaraya warar sheegaya in markab kalluumeysi oo Iiraan leedahay lagu afduubay xeebaha Bari
items.summary: Hawlgalka badda ee Midowga Yurub, ATALANTA, ayaa baaraya warar sheegaya in burcad-badeed ay 29 Oktoobar afduubeen markabka kalluumeysiga Azini ee Iiraan leedahay, meel u dhow degmada Bandarbeyla. Xarunta Amniga Badda ee MSCIO ayaa maraakiibta ganacsiga ugu baaqday inay feejignaan muujiyaan.
items.imageAlt: Astaanta Midowga Yurub oo ku taal markab dagaal oo ka qayb qaata hawlgalka Atalanta (sawir hore, 2009)

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Cumaan oo ka wada hadlay ballaarinta ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga
items.summary: Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan, ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay safiirka Cumaan u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Saalim bin Xabiib Al Camiri. SONNA ayaa sheegtay in kulanku diiradda saaray xoojinta ganacsiga labada dal iyo abuurista fursado cusub oo ganacsi.
items.imageAlt: Qasriga Al Alam ee magaalada Muscat, Cumaan

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka oo ka wada hadlay iskaashiga amniga iyo tababarka booliska
items.summary: Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), ayaa la kulmay Igor Zubov, ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Ruushka. Zubov ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu diyaar u tahay inay la wadaagto aqoonta iyo tababarka la dagaallanka dambiyada, sida uu sheegay Goobjoog.
items.imageAlt: Saraakiil booliska Soomaaliyeed oo tababar ku jira, Akadeemiyada Booliska Generaal Kaahiye, Muqdisho (sawir hore, 2014)

items.title: Dowladda federaalka oo bilowday qorshaynta waddo 110 km ah oo isku xirta Buuhoodle iyo Tuulo-Samakaab
items.summary: Horseed Media ayaa sheegtay in Wasiir Ayuub Ismaaciil oo ka tirsan dowladda federaalka uu saxiixay qorshaha waddada, iyadoo uu goobta joogay Xildhibaan Cabdi Qawdhan. Xildhibaanku wuxuu sheegay in mashruucu yahay guul weyn oo nolosha dadka deegaanka beddeli doona.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Buuhoodle (sawir hore, 2015)

items.title: Barcelona oo 6-1 ku jabisay Alavés, Lamine Yamal-na 2 gool dhaliyay
items.summary: Sida ay ESPN ku warantay, Barcelona ayaa 6-1 kaga adkaatay Alavés garoonka Spotify Camp Nou, waxayna dib ugu laabatay hoggaanka La Liga.
items.imageAlt: Lamine Yamal oo garoonka ku jira (2025)

items.title: Bayern iyo Dortmund oo 2-2 ku kala baxay, Harry Kane-na rigoore ayuu khasaariyay
items.summary: Sida ay ESPN ku warantay, Bayern Munich iyo Borussia Dortmund ayaa garoonka Allianz Arena 2-2 ku kala baxay ciyaarta Der Klassiker ee Bundesliga.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Allianz Arena ee Bayern Munich (sawir hore)

items.title: AC Milan oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter ciyaarta derby-ga Milan
items.summary: Sida ay ESPN ku warantay, AC Milan ayaa garoonka San Siro 3-1 kaga guuleysatay Inter, waxayna joojisay taxanaha Inter ee 9 ciyaarood oo horyaal ah oo aan laga badin.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka San Siro ee magaalada Milan (sawir hore)

items.title: Washington DC iyo Virginia oo dacwad ka gudbiyay qorshaha qaansada guusha ee Trump
items.summary: Sida ay Al Jazeera ku warantay, Washington DC iyo gobolka Virginia ayaa maxkamad federaal ah ka codsaday inay joojiso qorshaha Madaxweyne Trump ee ah in qaanso guul (triumphal arch) laga dhiso Memorial Circle, iyagoo ku tilmaamay mid sharci-darro ah.
items.imageAlt: Buundada Arlington Memorial iyo wabiga Potomac ee Washington, D.C.

items.title: Erdoğan oo ugu baaqay Ruushka iyo Ukraine inay joojiyaan weerarrada Badda Madow
items.summary: Sida ay Al Jazeera ku warantay, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa magaalada Istanbul, isagoo la taagan Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelenskyy, ku sheegay in weerarrada lagu qaado maraakiibta rayidka ee Badda Madow aan la aqbali karin, cid kasta oo fulisaba.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan (2025)

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo furay diiwaangelinta ururrada siyaasadda ka hor doorashooyinka 2027
items.summary: Sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay, diiwaangelinta ururrada siyaasadda ayaa socon doonta 1 ilaa 22 Nofembar. Soomaaliya waxay isu diyaarinaysaa doorashada baarlamaanka ee Abriil 2027 iyo doorashada madaxtooyada ee Maajo 2027.
items.imageAlt: Astaanta Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka

items.title: Madaxweyne Deni oo diiday jadwalka doorashada 2027, kuna baaqay gole ku-meel-gaar ah
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa wareysi uu siiyay telefishinka Puntland ku sheegay inuusan arkin doorasho uu Xasan Sheekh qaban karo, wuxuuna ku baaqay gole ku-meel-gaar ah oo dalka u horseeda doorasho. Dawan Africa ayaa xustay in eedeymaha uu soo jeediyay aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo ka hadlaya Golaha Wadatashiga Qaranka ee Muqdisho (2021)

items.title: Brighton oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Manchester City garoonkeeda
items.summary: Sida ay Al Jazeera ku warantay, Yasin Ayari ayaa daqiiqaddii 11aad dhaliyay goolka keliya ee ciyaarta, Brighton-na markii ugu horreysay ayay garoonka City kaga guuleysatay, iyagoo isku dayay 18 jeer.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Amex ee kooxda Brighton, Ingiriiska (2013)

items.title: Koonfur Afrika oo 176 orod kaga adkaatay Australia, taxanaha Test-kana ku guuleysatay
items.summary: Sida ay Al Jazeera ku warantay, Koonfur Afrika ayaa garoonka Newlands ku guuleysatay Test-kii 3aad, taxanahana 2-1 ku qaadatay, kadib markii Australia, oo looga baahnaa 288 orod, lagu wada saaray 111 orod.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka kirikitka ee Newlands, Cape Town

items.title: Chelsea oo 2-0 ku garaacday Manchester United, United-na 9 ciyaarood kuma guuleysan
items.summary: Sida ay Sky Sports ku warantay, Chelsea ayaa garoonka Stamford Bridge 2-0 kaga adkaatay Manchester United, kadib markii Lisandro Martínez laga saaray kaarka cas daqiiqaddii 63aad.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Stamford Bridge ee Chelsea, London, oo hawada laga sawiray (2023)

items.title: Somaliland oo ka digtay xadgudubyada loo geysto dadka Itoobiyaanka ah ee ku nool Boorama
items.summary: Wasiirka Warfaafinta Somaliland, Barkhad Jaamac Batuun, ayaa sheegay in aan loo dulqaadan doonin xadgudub ama cabsi gelin lagula kaco ajaanibta. Wuxuu sheegay in qofna aanu xaq u lahayn inuu si xoog ah u saaro ama u weeraro ajnabi, arrimahaasna ay mari doonaan habka sharciga, sida ay qortay Dawan Africa.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Boorama oo hawada laga sawiray (2024)

items.title: Ilaalada Xeebaha Mareykanka oo Soomaaliya ku dartay liiska dekedaha aan buuxin heerarka amniga
items.summary: Sida ay Garowe Online ku warantay, Ilaalada Xeebaha Mareykanka ayaa ogeysiis ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in dekedaha Soomaaliya aysan haysan tallaabooyin wax ku ool ah oo looga hortago argagixisada. Go'aanka oo dhaqan galay 27 Oktoobar wuxuu keenayaa hubin amni oo dheeraad ah oo lagu sameeyo maraakiibta Mareykanka u…
items.imageAlt: Konteenarro ku jira dekedda Muqdisho (sawir hore, 2015)

items.title: Achraf Hakimi oo saddex gool dhaliyay, PSG-na 5-1 ku garaacday Le Havre
items.summary: Sida ay ESPN ku warantay, PSG ayaa Jimcihii 5-1 kaga adkaatay Le Havre, daafaca reer Morocco Achraf Hakimi ayaa dhaliyay 3 gool, 2 kalena caawiyay.
items.imageAlt: Achraf Hakimi oo xiran funaanadda Morocco (2024)

items.title: Somaliland oo shacabka ka mamnuucday qaadashada hubka
items.summary: Sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay, taliyaha booliska Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada ammaanka la faray inay hubka ka qaadaan dadka aan haysan oggolaansho.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Hargeysa oo hawada laga sawiray (2022)

items.title: Muqdisho oo lagu xusay sannad-guuradii 103-aad ee Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga
items.summary: Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho ayaa xaflad u qabatay sannad-guuradii 103-aad ee aasaaska Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga. Guddoomiyaha Aqalka Sare, Cabdi Xaashi Cabdullaahi, ayaa sheegay in xiriirka labada dal uu ku dhisan yahay saaxiibtinimo iyo is-ixtiraam, isagoo xusay booqashadii Erdoğan ee 2011.
items.imageAlt: Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho

items.title: Uganda oo bilowday ka bixitaanka ciidamadeeda Soomaaliya kadib ku dhowaad 20 sano
items.summary: Taliyaha ciidamada Uganda, Jen. Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa sheegay in la bilaabay ka bixitaanka ciidamada UPDF ee Soomaaliya, amniganna loo wareejinayo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Garowe Online ayaa sheegtay in tallaabadu ay timid xilli miisaaniyadda taageerada hawlgalka AUSSOM la dhimay.
items.imageAlt: Ciidamada Uganda ee hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya oo salaan sharaf bixinaya (sawir hore, 2021)

items.title: Machadka Heritage oo daabacay daraasad ku saabsan doorka bulshada rayidka ee Soomaaliya
items.summary: Sida ay Dawan Africa ku warantay, Machadka Heritage ee Daraasaadka Siyaasadda ayaa soo saaray daraasad lagu qiimeynayo doorka, waxtarka iyo caqabadaha ururrada bulshada rayidka ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan kaalintooda daah-furnaanta iyo la xisaabtanka dowladda. Agaasimaha machadka, Mursal Maxamuud Saney, ayaa sheegay in…
items.imageAlt: Xubno ka tirsan ururrada bulshada rayidka ah oo ka qaybgalaya shir dadweyne oo Muqdisho ka dhacay (sawir hore, 2014)

items.title: Jen. Maxamed Cali Barise oo si rasmi ah ula wareegay xilka Taliyaha Ciidamada Xoogga
items.summary: Dawan Africa ayaa sheegtay in Jen. Barise, oo la magacaabay 25-kii Oktoobar, uu xilka kala wareegay Jen. Madey Nuuray Sheekh Ufurow. Barise ayaa horay xilkan u hayay 2019 ilaa 2020.
items.imageAlt: Askarta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka qeyb galaya dhoolatus ciidan (2013)

items.title: Hay'adda Batroolka: Ceelka saliidda ee badda Curad-1 wuxuu gaaray lakab muhiim ah
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Batroolka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in qodista ceelka Curad-1, oo ay wado shirkadda Turkiga ee TPAO, ay gaartay lakab ay ka muuqan karaan calaamadaha saliidda. Wuxuu sheegay in bartilmaameedka ugu dambeeya la filayo in la gaaro bisha Diseembar.
items.imageAlt: Markabka qodista saliidda ee Turkiga Kanuni (2020), ma aha Çağrı Bey

items.title: Somaliland oo dadkeeda ka mamnuucday ka qaybgalka siyaasadda Soomaaliya
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Somaliland ayaa soo saartay amar ay ku sheegtay in qof kasta oo ka qaybgala hawlaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya uu wajihi karo tallaabo sharci. Amarka lama caddeyn hawlaha uu khuseeyo iyo sida loo fulin doono.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Golaha Wakiilada ee Hargeysa (sawir hore, 2015)

items.title: Hawlgalka QM oo dhammaanaya iyadoo aan la helin hab lagu xalliyo khilaafka doorashada
items.summary: Hawlgalka siyaasadeed ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Sabtida soo afjarmaya iyadoo aan la isku raacin hab beddela oo dhexdhexaadiya muranka muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa mucaaradka ku casuumay wadahadal 14-18 Noofembar, balse kooxaha mucaaradka ee waaweyn weli ma xaqiijin ka-qaybgalkooda.
items.imageAlt: Shir Golaha Ammaanka QM uga socda xaaladda Soomaaliya (sawir hore, 2019)

items.title: Hirshabeelle oo ansixisay miisaaniyad $47.45 milyan ah oo sannadka 2027
items.summary: Dawan Africa ayaa sheegtay in golaha wasiirada Hirshabeelle, oo uu shir-guddoominayay Madaxweyne Guudlaawe, ay ansixiyeen miisaaniyadda 2027, taas oo 7% ka badan tii 2026. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay amniga, doorashooyinka iyo u diyaargarowga fatahaadaha.
items.imageAlt: Khariidadda Soomaaliya oo muujinaysa dowlad goboleedka Hirshabeelle

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo laba toddobaad hakiyay fadhiyada si loo rakibo nidaamka E-Parliament
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sheegay in fadhiyada la hakinayo laga bilaabo 31-ka Oktoobar. Wuxuu sheegay in nidaamka cusub uu dhaqan-galin doono codbixin elektaroonig ah iyo diiwaangelin dijitaal ah.
items.imageAlt: Xildhibaanno federaal ah oo fadhiya xaflad baarlamaan (2016)

items.title: Soomaaliya oo isu diyaarinaysa fatahaado El Niño oo laga cabsi qabo inay cunto-yaraanta kordhiyaan
items.summary: Sida ay Goobjoog ku warantay, Barnaamijka Cuntada Adduunka (WFP) iyo hay'adaha la shaqeeya ayaa xoojinaya qorshayaasha xaaladaha degdegga ah, oo ay ku jiraan digniin hore, waddooyin gaadiid iyo lacag caddaan ah, ka hor roobabka El Niño. Bulshooyinka webiyada u dhow ayaa lagu tilmaamay kuwa ugu khatarta badan.
items.imageAlt: Sawir dayax-gacmeed oo muujinaya fatahaad ku teedsan webiga Shabeelle

items.title: Midowga Yurub: Badeecadaha Soomaaliya waxay suuqyadiisa ku geli karaan canshuur la'aan
items.summary: Ergada Midowga Yurub ee Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay 33 dal oo Afrikaan ah oo nidaamka 'Everything But Arms' u oggolaanayo inay badeecadahooda, hubka mooyee, canshuur la'aan u dhoofiyaan Yurub. Goobjoog ayaa tilmaamtay in faa'iidadu ay ku xiran tahay in ganacsatadu buuxiyaan heerarka tayada…
items.imageAlt: Dekedda Berbera, oo badeecooyin badan laga dhoofiyo (2023)

items.title: Turkiga oo sheegay inuu markab cilmi-baaris iyo kalluumeysi u soo dirayo xeebaha Soomaaliya
items.summary: Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa xilli lagu xusayay Toddobaadka Kalluumeysiga Qaranka ee Muqdisho ku dhawaaqay in markab cilmi-baaris iyo kalluumeysi loo soo dirayo si loo xoojiyo xirfadda kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed. Magaca markabka iyo goorta uu imanayo lama shaacin.
items.imageAlt: Doonyaha kalluumeysatada iyo shabaagyo ku yaal xeebta Garacad

items.title: Itoobiya oo sheegtay inay Ruushka ka heshay 12 diyaaradood oo dagaal
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Itoobiya ay heshay 12 diyaaradood oo nooca Su-35 ah, ayna sugayso nidaamyo difaaca hawada ah oo S-400 ah, xilli xiisad ka taagan tahay xadka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarad dagaal oo nooca Su-35 ah

items.title: Wasiirka Tamarta oo kor u kaca qiimaha korontada Muqdisho ku sababeeyay qiimaha shidaalka
items.summary: Wasiir Cabdullaahi Bidhaan ayaa sheegay in kororka qiimaha korontada Muqdisho uu ka dhashay sicir-bararka shidaalka ee la xiriira xiisadda Bariga Dhexe, isagoo xusay in dowladdu ay hor istaagtay soo jeedin lagu labanlaabayay qiimaha.
items.imageAlt: Tiir koronto oo ku yaal Muqdisho (sawir hore, 2015)

items.title: Farmaajo oo baaritaan madax-bannaan ka dalbaday dagaalkii Jamea
items.summary: Madaxweynihii hore Farmaajo ayaa dowladda ku eedeeyay inay ciidamada u isticmaalayso khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka lagu dilay 75 dagaalyahan oo Al-Shabaab ah.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynihii hore Farmaajo oo khudbad jeedinaya (2017)

items.title: Soomaaliya oo daah-furtay qorshe shan sano ah oo ku saabsan dhallinyarada, nabadda iyo amniga
items.summary: Qorshaha 2026–2030 ayaa loogu talagalay in kaalinta dhallinyarada ee dhismaha nabadda la kordhiyo.
items.imageAlt: Dhallinyaro ka qaybgalaya shir dhallinyarada oo Muqdisho ka dhacay (sawir hore, 2016)

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo dib u dhigay safar uu ku tagi lahaa Ruushka
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa dib u dhigay safarkii loo qorsheeyay Ruushka. Warbixinta ayaa go'aankan la xiriirisay weerarrada Al-Shabaab iyo xiisadda doorashooyinka.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo shir ku jira (2015)

items.title: Shacabka ayaa gacanta u galay hubkii saarnaa gaariga la duqeeyay duleedka Buurhakabo
items.imageAlt: Askar ku sugan agagaarka Buurhakabo oo qorrax-dhac lagu sawiray (sawir hore, 2013)

items.title: Ciidamada Midowga Afrika oo isu diyaarinaya inay ka baxaan saldhigyo muhiim ah
items.summary: Ka bixitaanka ciidamada ayaa walaac ka dhex abuuray xaaladda amniga Soomaaliya.
items.imageAlt: Ciidamada Midowga Afrika oo garoonka Muqdisho ku sugaya diyaarad (2011)

items.title: Museveni oo Soomaalida ugu baaqay midnimo si looga adkaado Al-Shabaab
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Uganda ayaa sheegay in midnimadu tahay furaha looga adkaan karo caqabadda ugu weyn ee Soomaaliya haysata.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Museveni oo soo dhaweynaya Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, shirkii Kampala (2023)

items.title: Hawlgalkii siyaasadeed ee Qaramada Midoobay oo Soomaaliya ku dhammaaday
items.summary: Xiritaanka hawlgalka ayaa soo afjaraya in ka badan soddon sano oo taageero QM ah oo ku aaddan dhismaha nabadda iyo maamulka.
items.imageAlt: Nicholas Kay, madaxii ugu horreeyay ee UNSOM, oo Muqdisho yimid markii hawlgalka la aasaasay (2013)

items.title: Villa Soomaaliya oo si rasmi ah gogol wadatashi ugu fidisay Madasha Mucaaradka
items.summary: Madasha Mucaaradka, oo ay ku jiraan Deni iyo Axmed Madoobe, iyo xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol ayaa loo fidiyay wadatashiga, oo dhici doona 14–18 November.
items.imageAlt: Shan nin oo xubno ka ah Madasha oo sawir wadajir ah ka qaaday
